title: WebSocket Echo Server
description: Build a WebSocket echo server that upgrades HTTP connections to WebSocket and echoes back any message received.

steps.title: Health check endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /health endpoint that returns JSON with status ok.

steps.title: WebSocket upgrade endpoint
steps.description: Add a WS /ws endpoint that upgrades HTTP to a WebSocket connection. Return 101 on upgrade.
hints: Use express-ws or ws library to handle WebSocket upgrades
Create a ws /ws route that accepts connections

steps.title: Echo server with status endpoint
steps.description: Add a GET /ws-status endpoint that returns 200 confirming the WebSocket echo server is running.
hints: Track server state with a variable
Return JSON with { status: 'echo server running' }
Ensure /ws endpoint echoes messages back to client
